market.headline: Opex Friday closes red: SPY -1.10%, QQQ -2.49%, chips slide again and TSLA bounces off 349 late
market.note: SPY opened near 773, hit its high in the first minutes and bled to a 760.64 low before closing at 763.30, down 1.10% and 2% on the week. QQQ did twice the damage at -2.49% and -5.5% for the week as chips sold off again and oil pushed past 100 on Iran tension. That combo, hot inflation plus higher oil plus 5% yields, is what is hitting long-duration tech. TSLA found buyers near 349 and closed at 354.67, right under Thursday's 355.23 low. Monday's test is whether SPY can get back above 766.

portfolio.note: TSLL -4.5% and QLD -5.0% led the drop, TSLA -2.1% after its late bounce. The week is the TSLA stack and QLD sliding with QQQ.

watchlist.note: Closed near 763 after a 760.64 low; -2% on the week
Bounced from 349.33 low but closed just under 355.23
Held up better than most chip names again
Low near 703; reports Wed Oct 21 after the close
2x Nasdaq; down about 11% on the week
Worst on the list as AI data-center names get hit
Closed under 100 as risk appetite fades

catalyst.outlook: Today confirmed the morning's warning. Hot import prices and strong factory output already trimmed rate-cut hopes before the Oct 27-28 Fed meeting, and oil above 100 on Iran tension added fuel. That mix hits long-duration tech first, which is why QQQ fell more than twice as much as SPY and chips extended their slide. Next week the tone flips to earnings: Netflix Tuesday, then TSLA and META Wednesday night. If oil cools and those reports hold up, growth can bounce. If oil stays above 100, the pressure on QQQ and the TSLA stack likely continues.

today.name: Import Prices (Sep)
today.read: Hotter than expected and August was revised down to 0.5%. Fuel imports rose 4.8% and nonfuel 0.7%. Year over year import prices are up 8.1%, the largest gain since July 2022. That keeps pressure on yields and growth names like TSLA and QQQ even as the index holds near highs.

today.name: Industrial Production (Sep)
today.read: A clear beat. Manufacturing rose 0.3%, utilities jumped 3.5%, and third-quarter IP ran at a 2.8% annual rate. Growth is holding up despite hot energy costs, which softens the stagflation read from this week's inflation prints.

today.name: Capacity Utilization (Sep)
today.read: Utilization moved up but remains 2.5 points below its long-run average, so factory tightness is not the main inflation driver. Still a mild hawkish tilt alongside hot import prices.

today.name: Monthly options expiration
today.read: Opex did not pin SPY near the big 770 to 772 strikes. It broke below them and kept selling to a 760.64 low before closing at 763.30. With those positions gone, Monday can move more freely in either direction.

week.name: Cboe extended options hours begin
week.why: Early morning and late sessions start for SPY, QQQ and more. Expect thinner liquidity and wider spreads in those windows.

week.name: NAHB Housing Market Index (Oct)
week.why: Builder mood with mortgage rates above 7%. A read on how rates are biting the housing side of the economy.

week.name: Housing Starts and Building Permits (Sep)
week.why: More housing data. Weak numbers would support the case for easier policy despite hot inflation.

week.name: Netflix earnings (after the close)
week.why: First mega-cap tech report of the season. Sets the tone for growth names into TSLA and META.

week.name: TSLA, META, IBM, LRCX, TXN earnings (after the close)
week.why: The big one for you. TSLA margins, robotaxi and Roadster plans, plus META AI spend and LRCX and TXN reads on the chip slump.

week.name: Initial Jobless Claims
week.why: Claims have hovered near 200K. A jump would be the first crack in the labor market.

week.name: S&P Global Flash PMIs (Oct)
week.why: First look at October activity and price pressures. Watch the prices-paid parts for oil pass-through.

week.name: UMich Sentiment, final (Oct)
week.why: Inflation expectations matter here. Rising expectations would make the Fed's job harder the week before its meeting.

stocks.title: QQQ and SPY close lower on opex Friday
stocks.detail: SPY broke the 772 gamma level traders flagged and closed at 763.30, down 1.10%. QQQ fell 2.49% after losing the 715 to 724 support zone, and put buyers were posting big wins.

stocks.title: Chip stocks extend their longest losing streak since 2010
stocks.detail: SOXX fell another 4.2% today. X blames AI spending doubts and higher borrowing costs, with Micron swinging hard around 900.

stocks.title: Oil pushes past 100 as Iran tension escalates
stocks.detail: USO closed up 2.8% after reports of Iran forces on high alert and more tanker strikes near Hormuz. Higher oil feeds the inflation fears that are hitting tech.

stocks.title: Traders notice Monday is October 19, the Black Monday anniversary
stocks.detail: The 1987 crash happened on Monday Oct 19, and the date falls on a Monday again. Most posts call it a fun parallel, not a prediction, with QQQ and AI names already under pressure.

tech.title: Simulation says the new Tesla Roadster could beat an F1 pole lap at COTA
tech.detail: An engineer's sim using Tesla's specs puts it at 1:27.9 around Circuit of the Americas, versus a 1:32.5 F1 pole. Skeptics point to tires and braking the model skips.

tech.title: Slovakia becomes the ninth EU country to approve Tesla supervised driving
tech.detail: Tesla Assisted Driving got preliminary approval Oct 16 based on the Dutch RDW type approval. Drivers stay responsible, and a wider EU decision is still pending.

tech.title: Big debate: do AI models understand anything or just calculate?
tech.detail: Ctrl IQ CEO Gregory Kurtzer called LLMs next-word predictors with no comprehension, and Gergely Orosz pushed back on the AI psychosis label. Thousands of replies on both sides.

tech.title: Developers say AI tools mean longer days, not shorter ones
tech.detail: Engineers report bigger scopes and more time reviewing AI output. Economists call it the Jevons paradox: efficiency leads to more work, not less.

world.title: Iran vows to push US Navy ships farther from its coast
world.detail: Iran says it will force US warships beyond 500 km and reports hitting another tanker near Hormuz, with over 26 incidents in two weeks. US Central Command says commercial ships still pass.

world.title: Indonesia stocks crash 11% on MSCI downgrade threat
world.detail: The worst one-day drop in nearly 30 years forced a trading halt after MSCI opened a consultation on moving Indonesia out of emerging market status. The rupiah weakened too.

world.title: Pakistan will chair the IMF and World Bank boards in 2027
world.detail: Announced at the annual meetings in Bangkok, it is Pakistan's first time in the role since 1953. The chair rotates among members.

world.title: World Food Day street feast feeds over 50,000 in Ghana
world.detail: Chef Abbys' Big Street Feast served free Ghanaian food across Accra and Kumasi on Oct 16, under the UN theme Innovate Today, Nourish Tomorrow.

fact.claim: October is historically the S&P 500's worst month on average.
fact.explain: October has the scary reputation because of the 1929 and 1987 crashes, but its average return is positive. September is the month that has been weakest on average over the long run.

word.definition: Mental calm and steadiness, especially when things are stressful or going against you.
word.example: After a rough week, he met the premarket bounce with equanimity and stuck to his plan.

gbot.name: GROK
gbot.say: SPY settled -1.10% to score your call. TSLA bounced off 349 into the bell, and Monday is the Black Monday date.

items.title: TSLA closed a hair under Thursday's low
items.detail: TSLA hit 349.33, bounced into the close and settled at 354.67, just under Thursday's 355.23 low. Reclaiming 355 to 363 early next week would be a better setup into Wednesday night's earnings.

items.title: The leveraged names took the real hit this week
items.detail: SPY was down about 2% on the week and QQQ about 5.5%, but QLD fell about 11% and TSLL about 14%. That is the 2x math working against you on a falling week.

items.title: Brewers swept the Dodgers out of the NLCS
items.detail: That ends LA's three-peat bid with a 6-4 Game 4 win. X is pointing out that the Kobe and Shaq Lakers of 2000 to 2002 are still the last Big Four team to three-peat.

items.title: The new Roadster versus an F1 car
items.detail: An engineer's simulation using Tesla's specs has the Roadster lapping COTA in 1:27.9, about five seconds faster than an F1 pole. Production is aimed at 2028.

sports.title: Rice and Simmons are out vs the Chargers
sports.detail: Andy Reid ruled out Rashee Rice (hamstring) and LT Josh Simmons for Sunday. Xavier Worthy, Jalen Royals and rookie Kahlil Benson are in line for more snaps.

sports.title: Kenneth Walker III is rolling for KC
sports.detail: He has 537 rushing yards and four touchdowns in four games as a Chief, with three 100-yard games. X posts say a revenge trip to Seattle comes next week.

sports.title: Lakers wrap preseason tonight vs Denver
sports.detail: Final exhibition at Crypto.com Arena before the Oct 20 opener. Reports say LA talked with Milwaukee about Dalton Knecht for Jericho Sims and a second-round pick, or may waive him to get to 15.

sports.title: Chiefs host the Chargers Sunday at Arrowhead
sports.detail: KC plays without Rice. Check Sneed's final status before locking in any picks, and remember a bet against KC needs High confidence and a 5-point edge.
